_comment: Independent public-input witness for win/tty/wintty.c process_menu_window() (1547-1563, 1735-1741) reaching win/tty/getline.c xwaitforspace() (244-252): a Healer escapes the inventory menu, which stores 1 in ttyDisplay->dismiss_more, then opens the multi-drop menus, picks all types, and in the item menu types the count 2 followed by ^A (1). xwaitforspace() returns the ^A because it equals dismiss_more; no menu arm takes it, and the next pass resets the count, so selecting d drops the whole stack. In the second attempt a ^P at the command level has cleared dismiss_more (topl.c:116), ^A stays inside xwaitforspace(), the count survives and f drops two of three.
